title: Mixed Duo #021 · 여 토운드 밤쉘·프렌치레드립 / 남얼굴 사이렌 바스트 아워글래스·블루 라인
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in an empty sunlit stadium with green turf, a running track, standard-height gates and low stands behind her, warmly lit by the low golden sun, long soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in warm golden-hour sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult French woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, sleek silver-grey hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a silver barrel-shaped weight, a copper square-sided cowbell, a silver round bell, a gold hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked mixed-metal hair ornaments. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense morphing tessellation filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Iranian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a striking young male model face with sharp straight brows, a strong chin and a visible Adam's apple, a very faint trace of stubble, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, olive skin with a warm undertone, a relaxed half-smile, deep dark brown hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, an iron miniature anvil, a bronze cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop with a heavy rough copper a teardrop-shaped sinker hanging at its end, and a single mixed-metal necklace. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs), wide white bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense spiral resist motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme red ankle-strap stilettos with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
